rationale: Round 2 produced more quantified framing and clarified that a no-closure path could be financially viable only with large concessions, but the core dispute remains unresolved: workforce and state insist on no closures and no compulsory redundancies, while management and investors still keep closures on the table. Positions are more explicit, not substantively converged, and another round could still test whether a quantified no-closure package is possible.
